{{Quote|The writings I have collected in this volume appear in their original forms. Many are fragments of what once were longer works, but the preservation of what remains is less important than the recognition of how they led me to my new vision of the Sith order.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''''Absolute Power''''' was a collection of documents [[Writing/Legends|written]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Taken as a whole, the papers comprise a [[Politics/Legends|political]] manifesto of sorts, in which the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] documented many of his own beliefs and his theories with regard to his rise to power, as well as the steps he had taken to assure his own [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]].<ref name="BOS" />

==History==
[[File:Palpatine_SW_Kids_mag.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Palpatine, author of ''Absolute Power'']]
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] wrote about his rise to power from [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], expressing his theories on various subjects, describing how he had engineered the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and elaborating on his [[Rule of One (Palpatine's Doctrine)|Rule of One]]. This compendium of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Writing/Legends|writing]] was included in the ''[[Book of Sith]]'', a collection of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] texts. Ideas and elements originally formulated in the first three sections of ''Absolute Power'' were later included in the first three [[Book/Legends|books]] of Palpatine's ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]''.<ref name="BOS" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the ''Book of Sith'' was recovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who placed his own scrawled notes throughout the pages of Sidious' manifesto.<ref name="BOS" />

==Contents==
The journal included the following volumes:
*''[[The Book of Anger]]''&mdash;Of the harnessing of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] though emotion and anger.
*''[[The Weakness of Inferiors]]''&mdash;Of the way to compel the weak-minded to do one's bidding through the use of the Force rather than through violence.
*[[The Creation of Monsters|''The Manipulation of Life'']]&mdash;Of the proper mastering of the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to produce fearsome creatures [[Mutant|altered]] by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].
*''[[The False War]]''&mdash;Of the role of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the implementation of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].
*''[[The Useful Bureaucrats]]''&mdash;Of the way Palpatine manipulated many important figures and events that contributed to his rise to power, also making a minor statement of the role of his own master, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].
